# Breeze Agent Kit

> Solana yield strategies for AI agents.

Breeze Agent Kit lets AI agents deposit, withdraw, and check balances across Solana DeFi yield strategies. It supports multiple integration methods so agents can interact however suits their architecture.

## Integration Methods

### MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Stdio-based MCP server exposing tools: get_strategy_info, check_balances, get_deposit_tx, get_withdraw_tx, sign_and_send_tx. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible client.

### x402 (HTTP Payment Protocol)
Hono HTTP service at /deposit, /withdraw, /balance gated behind x402 USDC micropayments. Agents pay-per-call with no API keys needed.

### Skill (Cross-Model)
Reusable Breeze skill for agent workflows across Claude, GPT, Cursor, and other compatible clients.

### ClawHub
Install the Breeze skill with one command: `npx clawhub@latest install breeze`. Gives Claude Code the ability to automate yield on Solana assets via the x402 payment API.

## Supported Tokens
- USDC (6 decimals)
- SOL (9 decimals)
- JitoSOL (9 decimals)
- mSOL (9 decimals)
- JupSOL (9 decimals)
- USDT (6 decimals)
- USDS (6 decimals)
- JLP (6 decimals)
